name: Black-and-White Pinwheel Cookies
subtitle: Crisp vanilla and cocoa spirals
description: Two lightly sweetened doughs are layered, rolled, chilled, sliced, and baked into contrasting pinwheel cookies.

ingredients.item: egg plus 1 egg white for glazing

instructions.text: Combine the plain flour, icing sugar, vanilla sugar or caster sugar, and softened butter to form a dough. Knead briefly until smooth.
Divide the dough into two portions. Knead the cocoa and milk into one portion, leaving the other plain. Chill both portions.

Roll the plain and cocoa doughs into matching sheets on a lightly floured surface. Brush one sheet with the egg mixture, place the other on top, and brush the surface again as needed to help the layers adhere.
Roll the layered dough into a tight log. Wrap and chill until firm.
Preheat the oven to the required cookie-baking temperature and prepare a baking sheet.
Slice the chilled log into thick rounds and arrange them on the sheet with space between each.
Bake for 12 minutes, until the cookies are firm and fully set in the center; if checked with a thermometer, they should reach 160°F.
Cool on the baking sheet briefly, then transfer the cookies to a rack to cool completely.
